scheme_name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm
other_conditions: Only one member of the family can be the beneficiary of the scheme
Land must be owned by the family member or the beneficiary
Applicant must have obtained a loan for setting up the unit in the financial year 2023‑24 through a nationalized bank or a financial institution approved by the Reserve Bank of India
Establishment of the livestock unit requires a certificate from the Animal Husbandry Authority
Application must be confirmed within seven days of saving the online application and signed/fingerprinted by the beneficiary
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy up to 12 % on the loan for purchasing 1‑20 dairy animals, payable for five years.
